items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Then in the brass section was Louis Bacon, trumpet, Nelson Williams, trumpet

ctx.x: Nelson Williams, I think you mean.
Nelson Williams, that's right. That's his name, yeah.

items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know he was dead. I never heard no more from him, one way or the other.

ctx.x: Yeah, Nelson. I didn't know he was dead. I never heard no more from him, one way or the other. Nelson Williams, that's right. Boy, he could blow, though. He sure could blow.

Well, he was tall. You know, he had been in the Army, so he was muscular. He was kind of forward, you know, kind of pushy, but he wasn't smart. Do you understand what I mean? He was pushy but he wasn't smart, like I tell you. You're recording now?
